source: Owner-provided take-out menu, transcribed in apps/web/src/content/menu-catalog.ts; expanded by the owner’s photography brief.
style:
Use case: product-mockup, premium photorealistic Italian restaurant food photography. Create ONE photograph of the requested dish for Milano's Pizzas. Food subject is specified below.
Reference 1 is the approved Garlic Rolls photo: match its EXACT photographic style, 3:2 landscape framing, 45-degree camera, soft upper-left lighting, natural shadows, neutral dark brown wood tabletop, natural rich colors, subtle vignette, shallow f/1.8 depth of field, clean white ceramic dinner plate completely inside the frame. Replace the garlic rolls with ONLY the requested food. No garlic rolls unless specifically part of the subject.
Reference 2 is the exact NEW Milano's Pizzas semi-circle logo: red CRAFTED & FRESH top and pizza-slice arch, green MILANO'S PIZZAS banner, straight bottom slogan. The restaurant logo is a small real fired ceramic print on the front plate rim at six o'clock, about 12% of the plate diameter wide. It is NOT a digital overlay or sticker. The supplied semicircle mark is perspective-foreshortened along the sloped curved rim; its subtly softened ink edges and tiny density variations lie beneath the same translucent glossy glaze as the porcelain. Natural lighting, highlights and plate shading pass continuously across the ink. No raised edge, decal border, paper patch, drop shadow or embossed effect. Preserve red/green/black logo identity, but tiny lettering should have the natural optical softness of a photographed small stamp, not unnaturally sharp vector text. No old circular badge.
For soups or liquid sauces only, use an elegant plain white ceramic shallow bowl centered on the SAME white plate with its branded front rim visible. Otherwise use the same plate.
Highest native output resolution and hyper-real commercial food detail. Natural appetizing crisp textures, realistic moist surfaces, no fake plastic sheen, no oversaturation, correct food anatomy. NO people, hands, utensils, napkins, table props, drinks, text overlays, labels, border, watermarks or collage. One dish, one image. Keep full plate and front logo within frame.
OWNER-CONFIRMED PIZZA PREPARATION: Every pizza is thin-crust NEW YORK STYLE: thin flexible base, modest low golden edge, no thick or puffy Neapolitan crust. All toppings, including vegetables, herbs, ricotta and meats other than pepperoni, are placed UNDER the melted cheese; pepperoni alone is visible ON TOP of the cheese. Never scatter other toppings above the cheese. Hints of buried ingredients may show at cut edges, but the main surface is a continuous melted mozzarella layer. Sauce remains beneath cheese; cauliflower crust retains its specified ingredient.
RIM PLACEMENT REQUIREMENT: The restaurant logo is a small real fired ceramic print on the front plate rim at six o'clock, about 12% of the plate diameter wide. It is NOT a digital overlay or sticker. The supplied semicircle mark is perspective-foreshortened along the sloped curved rim; its subtly softened ink edges and tiny density variations lie beneath the same translucent glossy glaze as the porcelain. Natural lighting, highlights and plate shading pass continuously across the ink. No raised edge, decal border, paper patch, drop shadow or embossed effect. Preserve red/green/black logo identity, but tiny lettering should have the natural optical softness of a photographed small stamp, not unnaturally sharp vector text. Fit the COMPLETE logo, banner, slogan and every outline entirely within the FRONT WHITE RIM, with generous uninterrupted ceramic whitespace on all sides. Approximate width 145 pixels in a 1536-pixel image. Never overlap the inner bowl, food, the inner-well boundary or outer plate edge. Match the revised small Garlic Rolls stamp.
For soups: a SMALLER white bowl sits entirely inside the serving plate's central well, leaving a BROAD, UNOBSTRUCTED outer white plate rim. The small logo is centered on that outer plate rim, fully below and at least 25 pixels clear of the bowl, with visible white space all around it. Do not print a logo across two separate objects or any rim edge.
portionPolicy: Images show representative plated food, not guaranteed serving counts. Preserve specified counts for four sliders, six tenders, six-wing selection and four churros. A single image represents size alternatives. Identical dinner, lunch, side and catering foods may share a photograph; lunch drinks/rolls and full catering trays are not implied unless shown. Package compositions select only listed options.
assumptions: Pasta sauce choices use the named representative pasta shape in each subject.
The owner confirmed the Mixed Vegetables side contains carrots, broccoli, zucchini, cauliflower florets and yellow squash.
The garlic-oil image represents the dressing-or-garlic-oil row.
Meatballs represent the meatball-or-sausage catering row.
